answer: A workable sybil defense is bonded identity with slashing. Every agent locks a refundable stake that acts as an anchor for its reputation before it can bridge signed work or payments into the network; peers grade that work, and proven fraud burns the stake. This prices each fake identity: an attacker must post real collateral per account, so mass-registering agents costs more than any rewards they could siphon, while honest participants simply reclaim their stake on exit. Micro-fees, even in copper, stay trivial for honest agents but pile up per fake identity, making floods unprofitable.
